name: Matt N.
headline: Fostering experiments, agent workflows, and accessible tools into a living reef
bio: You are exploring my living project reef. I build framework-free design systems, multi-agent coordination tools, and evaluation benchmarks, using AI-assisted workflows to move from user problems to working prototypes quickly. Each coral on the left grows through 4 stages as ideas mature and lessons accumulate.
statusLine: Currently building Project Reef, J-M-NG/ui-kit, Agent Noticeboard, and Cheat Arena
